mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as investors allocate capital to risk assets during monetary easing.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% triggers Federal Reserve tightening, causing immediate S&P 500 sell-offs within 5 trading days as real rates rise and risk appetite declines.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >45% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and rises in nonfarm payrolls signal robust labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings to drive positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint UNRATE decline and PAYEMS rise fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >50% of cases, or interaction Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-pandemic recovery regimes (GDPC1 YoY > 2.0% and UNRATE < 5.0%), rising FEDFUNDS above 0.25% signals policy normalization, causing S&P 500 underperformance over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >55% of regime periods with FEDFUNDS > 0.25%, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1800 thousand units signal strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days via improved corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >55% of HOUST > 1800.0 periods, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained retail sales (RSAFS) above 12-month moving average indicates robust consumer spending, driving immediate S&P 500 gains within 5 trading days as earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >55% of RSAFS above 12-month MA periods, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO YoY > 2.5%) signals manufacturing sector weakness and impending economic slowdown, causing S&P 500 underperformance over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >55% of INDPRO YoY > 2.5% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales signal broad-based economic strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days via accelerated consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: Joint HOUST and RSAFS increases fail to produce positive 60-day returns in >50% of cases, or interaction Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.
